Enum Class CurrencyCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CurrencyCode>
com.eqixiac.equinix.internetaccess.enums.CurrencyCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
APIParam, Serializable, Comparable<CurrencyCode>, Constable
public enum CurrencyCode extends Enum<CurrencyCode> implements APIParam
ISO 4217 currency code of the billing account attached to an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 account (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts).
